sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-03)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the 74 CC packs whose race is `DragonRace` 012E82, `AlduinRace` 0E7713, `UndeadDragonRace` 1052A3, `DLC1UndeadDragonRace` 0117DE:Dawnguard.esm, `dlc2SpectralDragonRace` 01F98F:Dragonborn.esm, `DragonBlackRace` 02C88B:Dragonborn.esm or `DLC2DragonBlackRace` 02C88C:Dragonborn.esm (no NPC uses the last two), followed through every template and `LVLN`, plus every NPC templated on a dragon list (the `lvl*Dragon` wrappers and the named MQ dragons sit on race 109C7C, not a dragon race); then every placed reference in every cell and worldspace, and every quest that names one of them or one of their placed refs. No CC pack adds a dragon or overrides a dragon list, and no quest adds to a dragon list at runtime. Everything found is on a child page except the following.
